roll-prep.title: Roll Preparation
roll-prep.bite: Electoral rolls are updated — 97 crore voters verified, new registrations processed.

announcement.title: Announcement & MCC
announcement.bite: ECI announces the 7-phase schedule — Model Code of Conduct kicks in immediately.

nominations.title: Nominations & Scrutiny
nominations.bite: Candidates file nomination papers with affidavits on criminal cases, assets, and education.

campaigning.title: Campaigning
campaigning.bite: Political parties campaign across 543 constituencies — spending limits enforced.

polling.title: 7-Phase Polling
polling.bite: 642 million voters cast their ballots across 7 phases using EVMs with VVPAT.

counting.title: Counting & Results
counting.bite: EVM votes counted at 1,100+ centres — VVPAT verification performed.

evm.heading: EVM/VVPAT Lifecycle
evm.protocols_desc: Understanding the rigorous security protocols, multi-stage randomized checks, and secure storage facilities that protect the integrity of the vote.

stages.flc_desc: First Level Checking by BEL/ECIL engineers in presence of political parties.
stages.random_desc: Two-stage automated allocation to constituencies and specific booths to prevent targeted tampering.
stages.mock_desc: Conducted on poll day morning with minimum 50 votes cast and tallied against VVPAT slips.
stages.strong_desc: Post-poll secure storage under 3-tier security cover with CCTV monitoring.

civicFact.title: Today's Civic Fact
civicFact.fact: The Model Code of Conduct (MCC) comes into force immediately after the Election Commission announces the poll schedule, to ensure a level playing field.
